Subject: Lyra-Lite variant intake: compatibility checklist + pin recommendation

Hi all,

Greenfield wants to onboard Lyra-Lite (2.6B quantized) next week for an internal beta. They asked whether we can guarantee the same inference variant across hosted and dedicated (they care about consistency for A/B). Early compatibility run showed a tokenizer mismatch and a slightly different top-k with our default sampling kernel.

Ask: can platform + infra confirm whether a soft pin is advisable here (i.e., serve Lyra-Lite:v1.2 everywhere until we validate telem), and what gating criteria we need to escalate to Product for an enforced pin?

I attached a quick compatibility matrix from the intake test (lyra-lite-compat-matrix.xlsx). High level notes:
- Tokenizer: 3/12 edge cases where <|pad|> tokenization differs on long prefix prompts
- Sampling: small divergence in top-k behavior on GPU variant A vs B (affects safety prompts)
- Perf: Dedicated pool meets latency SLO at 2048 tokens; hosted shows higher p99 on bursts

Proposed next steps:
1) Infra runs a deterministic tokenization pass on a 500-prompt set (canary)
2) Product defines acceptable divergence thresholds for behavior gating
3) If criteria met, we put a soft pin (v1.2) and schedule a 48h telemetry review before lifting

Laura/Karthik/Marissa — can you each reply with the specific gate you own and eta? Alex — looping you so Greenfield knows the timeline.

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Product Manager, Model Onboarding | Redwood Inference

+1 on the checklist and thanks for the matrix, Priyom. I'll own the product gating criteria. Rough ETA: I can draft a proposal by EOD today; final sign-off by tomorrow morning if infra can get deterministic results by then.

Prelim gating items I'm planning to include:
- Tokenization divergence threshold (token-level F1 / 500-sample set)
- Safety signal delta (measured over our curated safety prompts)
- Regression allowance on intent classification tasks (compare to baseline on 2000 prompts)

If infra flags tokenizer as flaky across prefixes, we should favor the soft pin and extended telemetry.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Product, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lyra-Lite variant intake: compatibility checklist + pin recommendation

Quick infra update: we ran the deterministic tokenization pass locally against the 500-prompt canary. Results: tokenization mismatches are concentrated in prompts with repeated numeric sequences and long prefix context; divergence rate ~2.6% (13/500) using our standard tokenizer. The mismatch appears to be from a different normalization path in the model's converted vocab (we saw a mapping offset in the tokenizer table).

Impact on serving: both hosted and dedicated can serve the same binary, but the runtime sampling kernels differ between our GPU fleet families which produces the small top-k divergence. Options:
- Soft pin to Lyra-Lite:v1.2 across tiers; allow hosted fallback to v1.2-approx (same weights, sampling shim) until telemetry confirms parity
- Full pin (enforced): only if product deems the safety/regression deltas above thresholds

Also, operational constraints:
- We can deploy a shared binary in both environments by tomorrow 03:00 UTC if Marissa gives a final thumbs on model artifact and we run the mop-up runbook.
- Rolling back sampling kernel changes is low-risk but will add ~8 hours of canary validation.

I'll attach a short mop-up note (mop-up-runbook.md) with the steps we recommend. If Product signs the thresholds you outlined, infra can do the soft pin and schedule the 48h telemetry window.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Infra - Model Serving

Thanks everyone — summary and agreement:
- Laura will send final gating thresholds by 15:00 PT today.
- Karthik will prepare the soft-pin deployment (Lyra-Lite:v1.2) and run the 500-prompt canary; target deploy start 03:00 UTC tomorrow.
- Marissa: please confirm the model artifact (v1.2) readiness and whether there are any license/weights provenance notes we need to pass to Greenfield.

Alex — we'll aim to keep the soft pin for a 48h telemetry review and will share the dashboard link once live. If Product sees a safety/regression breach beyond thresholds, we will escalate to a full pin and notify Greenfield immediately.

If no objections, I will open a small internal ticket to track the tasks and notify CS for client comms.

PRI: Please reply with quick ack if you see anything missing.

—Priyom
